claims.statement: Source account 7675/8093BA230 sent 8 transfers to 8 distinct middle accounts between 2022-09-06 and 2022-09-08, totalling 54,791.17 USD, 12,583.90 EUR, 1,102,720.64 INR, and 22,304.22 CAD.
All 8 middle accounts paid final account 210261/803B8BFC0 in JPY between 2022-09-09 and 2022-09-10, totalling 10,489,436.82 JPY across 10 transfers.
Each middle account received exactly one transfer from the source and sent one or two transfers to the final account within 1-2 days, with no other activity in the alert window.

findings.narrative: Alert AL-833c795ec18e shows a textbook scatter-gather pattern. Source account 7675/8093BA230 sent funds to 8 distinct middle accounts between 2022-09-06 and 2022-09-08, using 5 different currencies (USD, EUR, INR, CAD, and one more USD). Each middle account then paid the same final account 210261/803B8BFC0 in JPY within 1-2 days, totalling ~10.49 million JPY across 10 transfers. The middle accounts acted as pure pass-throughs: each received once from the source and sent once (or twice) to the final account, converting to JPY. No ordinary business purpose explains dispersing funds to 8 accounts in multiple currencies only to reconverge them in a single currency at one destination within days. The quick turnaround, currency conversion, and lack of recurring counterparty relationships indicate layering.
